name: operations.decisions

list.description: Read bounded decision reports using the assigned business-field projection.

parameters.name: start-from
parameters.description: Inclusive native executionTimeStart lower bound, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss; source timezone unknown, offsets rejected.

parameters.name: start-to
parameters.description: Inclusive native executionTimeStart upper bound, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss; not before start-from.

parameters.name: created-from
parameters.description: Inclusive native gmtCreate lower bound, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss; source timezone unknown, offsets rejected.

parameters.name: created-to
parameters.description: Inclusive native gmtCreate upper bound, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss; not before created-from.

get.description: Read the entire independent native decision detail root; separate history is unqueried.

lookup.name: id
lookup.description: ASCII decimal native integer id from the decision List; no prior List/cache required.

result_identity.description: Exact native JSON integer id echo of the lookup.

purpose: Inspect operational decision reports independently of execution and history.

fields.name: id
fields.meaning: Native integer report identity; reportId, groupId and orderNo are distinct.

identity_description: Native JSON integer id, never a business-reference substitution or synthetic key.
limitations: Both inclusive native Start Time and Created Time ranges are required for acquisition; native timezone is unknown and never inferred. Bare offline List replays saved query context.

List deliberately publishes only the assigned decision-report business-field whitelist, preserving retained native strings, amounts, integer types, statuses and arrival order; operators, account numbers, free text, aliases and nested detail are excluded.
Qualified starting width1000 uses native offset and fixed total; this is not a measured backend maximum. Duplicate IDs, total drift, short nonfinal pages or missing coverage fail strict publication.
Independent POST JSON Get sends only integer id and preserves the full native root, including nested/unknown values. No history endpoint, child fanout, latest/version selection or List-row fallback.
--live --with-detail uses the selected List window and qualified same-value id binding; record projection does not alter full detail. Get/composition never save a List or import Duckdog data.
Failed or complete-empty refresh preserves any prior nonempty saved List under standard host policy. No runtime Duckdog import contract is introduced.
